content:
Overview

Melbourne is a city in Victoria with a population of 5,207,145. Australia’s cultural capital with world-class dining, street art, laneways, and a thriving sports scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
